record.issue_text: Duplicate-attendee growth: case-sensitive email dedup comparison creates duplicate attendee rows for emails differing only in case

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, deduplication against existing attendees is done with a case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and blacklist check `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` (where blacklist entries are lowercased but `guest` is not). On the client, uniqueness validation uses `new Set(emails)` which is also case-sensitive. Therefore emails differing only by case (e.g., `Test@x.com` vs `test@x.com`) will bypass dedup and can be inserted via `createMany`, creating duplicate attendee rows for the same underlying address.
